an3.137:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici tantāvutānaṃ vatthānaṃ kesakambalo tesaṃ paṭikiṭṭho akkhāyati.
an3.137:1.2: Kesakambalo bhikkhave sīte sīto uṇhe uṇho dubbaṇṇo duggandho dukkhasamphasso,
an3.137:1.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici puthu samaṇappavādānaṃ Makkhalivādo tesaṃ paṭikiṭṭho akkhāyati.
an3.137:2.2: -n' atthi kammaṃ, n' atthi kiriyaṃ, n' atthi viriyan ti. 2.
an3.137:2.3: Ye pi te bhikkhave ahesuṃ atītaṃ addhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā te pi Bhagavanto kammavādā c' eva ahesuṃ kiriyavādā ca viriyavādā ca.
an3.137:2.4: Te pi bhikkhave Makkhali moghapuriso paṭibāhati --
an3.137:2.5: n' atthi kammaṃ, n' atthi kiriyaṃ, n' atthi viriyan ti. 3.
an3.137:2.6: Ye pi te bhikkhave bhavissanti anāgataṃ addhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā te pi Bhagavanto kammavādā c' eva bhavissanti kiriyavādā ca viriyavādā ca.
an3.137:2.7: Te pi bhikkhave Makkhali moghapuriso paṭibāhati --
an3.137:2.8: n' atthi kammaṃ, n' atthi kiriyaṃ, n' atthi viriyan ti.
an3.137:2.9: Aham pi bhikkhave etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kammavādo kiriyavādo viriyavādo.
an3.137:2.10: Mam pi bhikkhave Makkhali moghapuriso paṭibāhati --
an3.137:2.11: n' atthi kammaṃ, n' atthi kiriyaṃ, n' atthi viriyanti. 5.
an3.137:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave nadī-mukhe khipaṃ uḍḍeyya bahunnaṃ macchānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya vyasanāya, evam
an3.137:3.2: eva kho bhikkhave Makkhali moghapuriso manussakhipaṃ maññe loke uppanno bahunnaṃ sattānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya vyasanāyāti. 136.
